rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that is not expensive and is reasonably affordable.

example.english: The food at this cha chaan teng is affordable.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caa4 gei3 di1 je5 m4 gwai3

rows.jyutping: fu6 daam1 dak1 hei2 ge3 A
rows.note: Use this when the price is affordable relative to the buyer's budget or means.

example.english: This second-hand computer is affordable for me.
example.traditional: 呢部二手電腦係我負擔得起嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 ji6 sau2 din6 nou5 hai6 ngo5 fu6 daam1 dak1 hei2 ge3
